svg.title: Left: median ADF statistic against d for simulated series of integration order 0.4, 0.7 and 1.0, with 10 to 90 percent bands. Right: distribution of the chosen d* for each order, with the theoretical value dotted; every distribution sits to the left of its theoretical value except for order 0.4.
